verdict.rationale: Ongoing watchlist re-screening is a fair question for a KYC/identity-verification product, so the axis applies. The evidence covers only one-time document, selfie, and ID-number checks, with webhooks firing when a verification session changes status. Nothing shows sanctions/PEP watchlist screening, continuous monitoring of already-verified users, or events triggered by watchlist updates; the document blocklist only blocks future verifications with the same document.
